---
title: "Weather at a New York State Station, 1981-2010"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("ny_noaa")

noaa_clean =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")),
    month = factor(format(date, "%b"), levels = month.abb),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10
  )

featured_station =
  noaa_clean |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarize(
    complete_temperature_days = sum(!is.na(tmax) & !is.na(tmin)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(complete_temperature_days, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  pull(id)

station_weather =
  noaa_clean |>
  filter(id == featured_station)

annual_temperature =
  station_weather |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    `Average maximum` = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Average minimum` = mean(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Average maximum`, `Average minimum`),
    names_to = "temperature_type",
    values_to = "temperature"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hover_text = str_c(
      "Station: ", featured_station,
      "<br>Year: ", year,
      "<br>", temperature_type, ": ", round(temperature, 1), " °C"
    )
  )

annual_snow =
  station_weather |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    snowy_days = sum(snow > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Annual Average Temperature (Station `r featured_station`)

```{r temperature-line, echo=FALSE}
annual_temperature |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year,
    y = ~temperature,
    color = ~temperature_type,
    colors = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77"),
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average temperature (°C)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Temperature measure"))
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Maximum Temperature by Month

```{r temperature-box, echo=FALSE}
station_weather |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~tmax,
    type = "box",
    color = ~month,
    colors = "viridis",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

### Snowy Days by Year

```{r snow-bar, echo=FALSE}
annual_snow |>
  mutate(
    hover_text = str_c("Year: ", year, "<br>Snowy days: ", snowy_days)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year,
    y = ~snowy_days,
    type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = "#5B8E7D"),
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Days with snowfall")
  )
```
